findings.topic: Do not count every YAML guid token as an asset reference
findings.evidence: Pristine SoundMixer.mixer six m_ExposedParameters guid values had no corresponding .meta because they are internal mixer parameter identities; TimelineTest000 two missing-prefab GUIDs occur inside m_Name strings. Only one genuine missing script GUID across4PPtrattachments remained.
findings.recommendation: Static GUID audits should parse PPtr records (fileID plusguid), distinguish internal IDs/name strings, then resolve imported subassets separately.

findings.topic: Generator full-byte consumption alone does not prove managed header alignment
findings.evidence: 726recovered MonoBehaviour headers independently matched raw GameObject/Enabled/Script/Name fields after m_Enabled alignment flag16384 correction.
findings.recommendation: Compare generated decoder headers against independent raw/native header pointers; retain exact-byte checks and target-existence checks as additional dimensions.

findings.topic: A temporary editor render-pipeline probe can persist project settings despite finally restoring live object references
findings.evidence: Unity2023.2.22f1 probe saved null pipeline refs in GraphicsSettings/QualitySettings and changed active quality antiAliasing2to0. Probe assignmentsRestored=True was insufficient. Post-test SHA256 caught both files; exact frozen bytes were restored and all files rechecked.
findings.recommendation: Back up exact GraphicsSettings/QualitySettings bytes before probing; restore runtime assignments in finally, then compare hashes after editor exit and restore exact bytes if needed. Never treat an in-memory equality check as proof of unchanged on-disk settings.
